verdict.rationale: Databricks documents a self-serve Free Edition: a no-cost workspace where anyone can explore datasets and work with notebooks and AI tools. It replaced Community Edition, and a separate free trial account is offered. Getting-started tutorials show querying sample data in Unity Catalog, which covers the core evaluation path without a sales engagement. Missing for 10: an explicit statement that no credit card is required, documentation of Free Edition limits and whether you can load your own (real) data, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the signup experience.
